result.edit: The failure shows the output was 1 when expected to be 0 at count=4 cycle=8 mode=1. In mode=1 (odd period), the condition for setting clk_out_r was using div_o>>1 (div_o/2) instead of div_o>>2 (div_o/4) as specified. Changing to div_o>>2 matches the public waveform contract where output should be 1 iff count <= floor(div_o/4) + 1 in odd mode.
